title: Write the design doc for running independent jobs in parallel
summary: Add one design doc under docs/design for running independent jobs concurrently in `athena go`, covering per-job branch/PR landing at design level only. No code, no review file, no build: those are separate later jobs.

defaults_applied.how: The user asked for the design first, with the review and build as later jobs.
The doc cites the code and docs it relied on.
The doc is written for an outside reader.
A later independent job reviews the doc; this job is checked by diff inspection.
Hidden requirements were recovered from the earlier readings and the user's replies.

assumptions: The doc's file name is docs/design/parallel-jobs.md, following the naming of the existing design docs.
The independent review, the implementation, tests, README and CHANGELOG updates, and the decisions.md entry are later jobs.
Native PR landing is designed here as an interaction (one branch/PR per job) and not built.
The doc may cite the existing code and design docs it read, per the evidence default.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new file docs/design/parallel-jobs.md exists and states the problem: jobs run one at a time, and queued jobs must be run by hand.
The doc specifies the concurrency model (threads vs. separate processes), the worker bound and its default, and how the existing job and repository locks are reused.
The doc specifies how the kill switch (refuse_if_stopped) and per-job budgets apply to every parallel job, and how failure is isolated so one job's failure or lock conflict does not abort the others.
The doc specifies the CLI surface (multi-job and --all form, per-job result lines, exit codes with single-job behavior unchanged) and how conflicting jobs end stale or blocked, never merged silently.

The doc has a section on landing each parallel job as its own branch/PR, designed and explicitly marked not built, and consistent with docs/design/native-pr-landing.md and docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md.

The doc lists alternatives considered with reasons for rejection, open questions for the reviewer, and a build plan splitting later review and implementation jobs. It states that the independent review is pending.
No Rust source, Cargo, config, CI, README, CHANGELOG, or docs/design/reviews files change. A decisions.md entry is deferred to the build job.
Run `git status` and `git diff --stat`: only docs/design/parallel-jobs.md is added or modified. Run `cargo fmt --check`: it passes.

out_of_scope: The independent review file under docs/design/reviews
Any implementation in crates/ or xtask/
departures: A docs-only job is cheaper and faster than the reference, which mostly covers code jobs.
